title: Implement crash resume
notes: Implemented QAController.resume_from_crash() to safely restore started_at, epoch, action_count, thread_id, scenario cursor & seed, candidate worktree, branch, and base SHA from DB.
Added strict validation requiring candidate worktree to exist and match persisted candidate HEAD, failing closed on discrepancy.
Allowed INIT -> START_MESA transition in StateMachine for crash resumption.
Added --resume <run_id> support to 'mesa-qa run' CLI subcommand.
